requirements.description: User wants the property near healthcare services. Threshold set at the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75. Relevant for a residential senior care facility (RSA).

User prefers energy class D or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through D. Area (1,600 sqm), capacity (30 people) and proximity to healthcare services are not energy efficiency parameters and have no matching columns, so they are not included.

typologies: Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 1,600 sqm of gross floor area. The 30-person capacity is not converted to an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Energy class (D or better) and proximity to healthcare services are not reference columns and are not mapped here.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 1600 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND healthcare >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area >= 1600, energy_class from A1 to D, and healthcare >= 75, plus a 3.0 km haversine radius around the supplied coordinates. The tipologia_bene_immobile requirement was dropped because that column is not in filterable_columns, so the property-type filter is not applied. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates.
